paragraphs: Overall credibility check result: not passed. For step s1 (static), reaction balance passed, so the applied load is balanced by the support reactions. Mesh quality also passed, with no inverted elements and very few badly shaped ones.

The maximum von Mises stress convergence check did not pass. The peak stress rises with each refinement, from {{s1.conv2.level0}} on the first mesh to {{s1.conv2.level1}} on the second and {{s1.conv2.level2}} on the third. This points to a suspected stress singularity, such as a sharp corner or point load. The reported maximum von Mises stress of {{s1.vm_max_mpa}} (away from constrained faces) therefore cannot be used as a design basis, and the results cannot be called converged or reliable. For reference, the material yield strength is {{s1.strength_mpa}}, but no comparison is drawn because the stress check failed.

The maximum displacement convergence check passed. Values are {{s1.conv3.level0}}, {{s1.conv3.level1}} and {{s1.conv3.level2}} across the three meshes, giving a maximum displacement of {{s1.u_max_mm}}. This only describes displacement and does not offset the stress check failure.
No safety factor is given because the credibility checks did not pass (overall result: not passed).

Limitations: linear elastic, small deformation; no contact; residual stress and surface hardening are not considered. Stresses near constrained and loaded faces come from idealized boundary conditions and were excluded from the maximum stress evaluation. Stress at sharp corners grows with mesh refinement (theoretical singularity) and should not be used directly for design.
suggestions: Locate the point of maximum stress and check whether it lies at a sharp corner or point load in the geometry.
If the corner is a real feature, add a realistic fillet radius to the model and refine the mesh locally around it, then rerun the convergence study.
If the point load is an idealization, replace it with a distributed load over the actual contact area and rerun.
Evaluate stress away from the singular location, or use a method such as stress linearization along a section, and have an engineer review it before using it for design.
Rerun the mesh convergence check on maximum stress after these changes, and only consider a safety factor once all credibility checks have passed.
